tools.name: search_tenders
tools.description: Search official European TED procurement notices by buyer country (3-letter ISO), optional 8-digit CPV, recent days, and limit. Results include TED source URLs. Read-only; ACTIVE does not guarantee the bid deadline is open.

tools.name: match_tenders
tools.description: Rank up to 25 recent TED notices using optional CPV and business keywords. Returns transparent rule-based scores, not eligibility decisions. Searches only a recent sample, not all TED notices. Free, read-only.
